name: policy-dev
description: /policy-dev: attach a human video, type the task, send; a settings dialog opens; Run starts the pipeline. Stages: video, extract (hurobo, markers required), demospec, prompt, generate, nominal, attack, diagnose, rewrite, gate, deploy. Plain data: any agent can read these defaults and limits; the Studio server and dialog read them from this file. Bowl-on-plate only. Muse tokens cost about $13.5 per million.

scene_context.note: Same S4 description and e3 repair evidence as the experiments, but measured in the stock scene these runs simulate, on the debug seed. The S4_L* files describe the scaled scene. Made by ants.studio.stock_scene on first use: one no-op rollout, no tokens.

extraction.note: Only clips of the ArUco/ChArUco marker setup can be extracted. Marker size is the measured 5.75 cm; the stored demospecs used 6.0 cm.

budget.note: Budgets are checked before each model call, so one call can overshoot; each stage keeps one call of headroom below the cap. Retries plus rewrites can need more than the cap; the run then ends as a budget stop.

synthesizer.label: Synthesizer module
synthesizer.help: Off: no generation and no rewrites; give the main robot script, which is attacked and reported on.

adversary.label: Adversary module
adversary.help: Off: after generation, save the main program to data/deploy/; no attacks.

pause_after_v0.label: Stop after candidate v0
pause_after_v0.help: Hold before the Adversary with the rollout of v0 on screen until you continue. Spends nothing while waiting.

spark.label: Muse Spark (Adversary)
spark.help: On: Muse Spark proposes attacks, diagnoses failures and explains them; adds cost. Off: uniform proposals and rule diagnosis, free.

spark_token_cap.label: Muse Spark token cap
spark_token_cap.help: Separate from the Synthesizer cap. When it is spent, the Adversary falls back to the free behaviour.
